name: Wolfkin
description: (Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a Wolfkin, a half-beast with wolf traits including wolf ears, tail, retractable claws, and sharp teeth. In some individuals, the wolf traits show more dominantly. You gain increased physical abilities, senses, and a fierce hunting instinct. You can also convey your intent to other animals, even if you cannot understand them back.
